items.name: Airbyte
items.description: Data movement platform with a large catalog of connectors that load APIs, databases and files into warehouses and lakes.

items.name: Apache Flink CDC
items.description: Streaming data integration tool built on Flink that captures database changes and writes them to lakehouse tables.

items.name: Apache Kafka
items.description: Distributed event streaming platform, often the source of real-time lakehouse ingestion.

items.name: Apache NiFi
items.description: Visual system for routing, transforming and delivering data flows between systems.

items.name: Apache SeaTunnel
items.description: Distributed data integration tool for batch and streaming synchronization between many sources and sinks.

items.name: Debezium
items.description: Change data capture platform that streams row-level changes from databases.

items.name: Estuary
items.description: Managed platform for change data capture and streaming or batch pipelines.

items.name: Fivetran
items.description: Managed ELT service that replicates data from applications and databases into warehouses and lakes.

items.name: ingestr
items.description: Command-line tool that copies data between databases and other sources with a single command.

items.name: Onehouse
items.description: Managed lakehouse service for ingesting data and optimizing Apache Hudi, Apache Iceberg and Delta Lake tables.

items.name: Redpanda Connect
items.description: Declarative stream processor with connectors for moving data between streaming systems, databases and lakes.

items.name: Sling
items.description: Command-line tool that extracts data from a source and loads it into a target database, warehouse or file store.

items.name: Apache Hive
items.description: SQL data warehouse system for large datasets in distributed storage, and the origin of the Hive Metastore.

items.name: Coalesce
items.description: Visual and code-based platform for building and governing SQL transformations.

items.name: Dataform
items.description: Google Cloud service for developing, testing and scheduling SQL transformations in BigQuery.

items.name: dbt
items.description: Framework for building, testing and documenting SQL transformations with software engineering practices.

items.name: Materialize
items.description: Streaming SQL engine that keeps materialized views up to date as source data changes.

items.name: RisingWave
items.description: Streaming SQL engine that ingests, transforms and serves event streams, with Apache Iceberg support.

items.name: SQLMesh
items.description: Data transformation framework with virtual environments and column-level lineage, compatible with dbt projects.

items.name: Amazon Athena
items.description: Serverless SQL query service for data in Amazon S3 and other sources.

items.name: Amazon Redshift
items.description: Cloud data warehouse from AWS that can also query open table formats in Amazon S3.

items.name: Apache Doris
items.description: Real-time analytical database that can also query data lakes directly.

items.name: Apache Drill
items.description: Schema-free SQL query engine for files, NoSQL stores and other self-describing data.

items.name: Apache Druid
items.description: Real-time analytics database for fast aggregations over streaming and historical event data.

items.name: Apache Impala
items.description: Distributed SQL query engine for data in HDFS, Apache Ozone and object stores.

items.name: Apache Kylin
items.description: OLAP engine that speeds up multidimensional analysis with precomputed cubes and indexes.

items.name: Apache Kyuubi
items.description: Multi-tenant gateway that serves SQL over Spark, Flink, Trino and other engines.

items.name: Apache Pinot
items.description: Real-time analytics database built for low-latency, user-facing queries.

items.name: ClickHouse
items.description: Column-oriented analytical database that can also query open table formats in object storage.

items.name: Databricks SQL
items.description: SQL warehouse on the Databricks lakehouse platform.

items.name: Dremio
items.description: Lakehouse platform and SQL query engine built around Apache Iceberg and Apache Arrow.

items.name: Firebolt
items.description: Analytical data warehouse aimed at low-latency, high-concurrency queries.

items.name: Google BigQuery
items.description: Serverless data warehouse from Google Cloud that can also query open table formats.

items.name: Microsoft Fabric
items.description: Microsoft analytics platform that combines lakehouse, warehouse, data engineering and BI on OneLake.

items.name: MotherDuck
items.description: Managed cloud data warehouse built on DuckDB.

items.name: Presto
items.description: Distributed SQL query engine for querying data where it lives, hosted by the Linux Foundation's Presto Foundation.

items.name: SingleStore
items.description: Distributed SQL database that combines transactional and analytical workloads.

items.name: Snowflake
items.description: Cloud data platform with a SQL engine that works on its own storage and on Apache Iceberg tables.

items.name: Starburst
items.description: Commercial lakehouse platform built on Trino.

items.name: StarRocks
items.description: Distributed SQL engine for low-latency analytics on and off the data lakehouse, hosted by the Linux Foundation.

items.name: Trino
items.description: Distributed SQL query engine for querying data across lakes, warehouses and databases.

items.name: Apache Flink
items.description: Distributed engine for stateful stream and batch processing, with Java, Python and SQL APIs.

items.name: Apache Spark
items.description: Unified engine for large-scale data processing, with Python, SQL, Scala, Java and R APIs.

items.name: Apache DataFusion
items.description: Extensible query engine written in Rust on Apache Arrow, with SQL, DataFrame and Python APIs.

items.name: DuckDB
items.description: In-process analytical SQL database with first-class Python support and table-format extensions.
